exports.label: Cobalt intermediates and metal
exports.n: 2024 figure: DR Congo suspended exports until 15 October 2025 and has capped them by quota since 16 October 2025 (see the notes)
exports.warn: Gross weight of cobalt intermediate products and metal (ores are a small part): not comparable with mine production, which is in tonnes of contained cobalt.
Customs tonnage: some origins are recorded badly (see the notes on the commodity page).

exports.n: 12% of tonnage from flows with implausible unit values (kept because the flow is below the USD 50 million correction rule)

exports.warn: This ranks customs trade, not refinery output: countries that store, blend and re-export products may rank high, which the atlas does not measure.

imports.warn: Customs trade, not final demand: countries that store, blend and re-export products may rank high, which the atlas does not measure.

imports.n: Atlas estimate: 78% of this tonnage is estimated from the declared value (customs declared 0.00 Mt for these flows; declared value divided by a reference unit value, see the notes of the page)

imports.warn: Product weight of potassium chloride, not K2O content.

production.warn: World total 20% above the ICCO's estimate for the 2023/24 crop year (4,362 kt): see the discrepancies.

consumption.warn: The United States is converted from EIA's barrels per day at 11.60 barrels per tonne (Atlas conversion): EIA's tonnes for the country are missing from 2022 and out of line with its barrels per day in 2021, and its world total in tonnes leaves the country out; the world total here puts it back.

reserves.n: EIA raised its estimate from 88.0 Mt to 988.0 Mt in 2014, a 11-fold step, and has not changed it since; treat this rank with caution
reserves.warn: Kyrgyzstan: EIA raised its estimate from 971.0 Mt to 28,499 Mt in 2014, a 29-fold step, and has not changed it since; treat this rank with caution.
